spirit_lantern.name: Spirit Lantern
spirit_lantern.lore: A cold flame that answers. The Lantern Court offering wants it.

bell_key.name: Bell Key
bell_key.lore: Opens the tolling door of the Hollow Bell Sanctum.

waves.say: The whispers gather. Something answers the plate.

onDone.text: The whispers fall silent. A Spirit Lantern burns on the plate.
A stone lid grinds aside. A long nave of statues lies beyond.
The last of the dead are remembered. The door to the Lantern Court opens.

mechanics.failText: The dead are not remembered. Read the colour strip on the north wall again.

onDone.text: The braziers catch. The whispers die and a wall opens in the south side of the nave.

onOpen.text: The lantern burns on the altar and a tomb door grinds open in the south.

mechanics.hint: An altar bowl, empty. It wants a light of the dead.
mechanics.verb: sets the Spirit Lantern on the altar and a tomb door grinds open.

onOpen.text: A bell tolls. The Hollow Bell Sanctum opens.

mechanics.hint: A tolling door with a keyhole shaped like a clapper.
mechanics.verb: turns the Bell Key and the tolling door swings wide.

encounters.say: The coffins hum. The whispers know your name.
Lanterns burn without flame. A great bell hangs unrung.

bosses.name: The Hollow Bell
bosses.intro: The Hollow Bell tolls and something answers from inside it. Put out the three froglights on the pillars.
bosses.deathText: The Hollow Bell cracks and falls silent.

shield.breakText: The lights gutter out! The Hollow Bell is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Hollow Bell calls its servants.

effects.text: The dead stand up around the bell.

completion.intro: The Hollow Bell Crypt. Light the garden shrine, pass the nave, and answer the dead.
completion.message: The bell is quiet. The crypt closes shortly.
